findings.text: Open Instruct and Base weights are released under Apache 2.0 (141B total parameters, 39B active).
The model is marked retired on the docs page, with retirement date 3/30/2025 and replacement Mistral Small 4.

source.quote: This model is retired. Use Mistral Small 4 for new integrations. Retirement date 3/30/2025 Replacement Mistral Small 4

notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mixtral-8x22b-0-1-0-3). It is a product/model catalog page (date, context, license, params, modalities, weights), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Specs come from the page HTML/RSC (header Modalities Text input/Text output as tooltip labels, Context 64k, Weights table Parameters 141 / Active 39, Context 64k). Architecture taken from the tagline MoE wording. Header date April 17, 2024 treated as releaseDate following the same pattern as other Mistral docs cards (page does not say 'released on'). Blog post mistral-mixtral-8x22b-blog (https://mistral.ai/news/mixtral-8x22b) and legal.mistral.ai page were not used for numbers; seed-lookup listed only this document for the card. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup. Base weights are listed on the page but seed covers only Instruct.
